title: Google Workspace
summary: Groups the reviewed gws and gog command rules for Gmail delivery, Drive and Calendar sharing, destructive changes, exports and account overrides.

operationFamilies.title: Sharing, calendar access and mail routing changes
Sign-in, credential export and account overrides
Generic API, batch and raw requests

notCovered.title: Search and read
notCovered.reason: Reads emit no pack observation and keep the inherited native floor.

notCovered.title: Draft creation
notCovered.reason: Draft routes emit no pack observation, although a draft already leaves the device.

notCovered.title: Labels, archive and trash volume
notCovered.reason: No rule counts changes against a volume cap or business budget.

notCovered.title: Account and audience binding
notCovered.reason: The rules do not resolve the effective account or tell internal recipients from external ones.

notCovered.title: Workspace MCP servers
notCovered.reason: Remote Workspace MCP tool calls are not part of this pack.

limitations: Selecting the pack does not enable an extension; each one stays inert until local extension control enables it.
Role suggestions are presentation only and can keep or tighten a baseline floor, never lower it.
This is a proposed grouping, not a qualified business mode or a protected account journey.
